stem: Rooting performance falls across several genotypes immediately after a documented room-control change. What is the best troubleshooting strategy?
choices: Assume every donor declined at the same time
Evaluate the shared environmental/process change and timing before assigning separate genotype causes
Change media, environment, and inputs simultaneously
Wait for complete crop loss before collecting data
rationale: A common performance shift across genotypes following a shared process change is strong evidence for investigating that common factor first while preserving comparative data.
